llm.reply:
The genes associated with these conditions are NCBIGene:672, BRCA1 DNA repair associated [1], and NCBIGene:675, BRCA2 DNA repair associated [6]. The retrieved conditions are mainly hereditary cancer susceptibility syndromes and Fanconi anemia subtypes. The records do not state which gene each disease is linked to.

## Hereditary Breast Cancer

One associated condition is Familial cancer of breast [2]. Another is Familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 1 [3]. A third is Familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 2 [9]. Familial prostate cancer is also listed [11].

## Other Cancer Susceptibilities

Pancreatic cancer susceptibility 4 is associated [4]. Pancreatic cancer susceptibility 2 is also associated [12]. Glioma susceptibility 3 appears among the conditions [10]. Medulloblastoma is listed [7]. Wilms tumor 1 is listed as well [13].

## Fanconi Anemia

Fanconi anemia complementation group S is associated [5]. Fanconi anemia complementation group D1 is also associated [8].

## Biological Context

The BRCA1 protein helps maintain genome integrity and suppresses tumours [24: "plays a role in maintaining genomic stability, and it also acts as a tumor suppressor"]. Its roles include repair of double-strand DNA breaks [24: "plays a role in transcription, DNA repair of double-stranded breaks, and recombination"]. BRCA1 mutations account for a large share of inherited disease [24: "responsible for approximately 40% of inherited breast cancers and more than 80% of inherited breast and ovarian cancers"]. A linked process is double-strand break repair via homologous recombination [21].

The knowledge graph links BRCA1 and BRCA2 to a set of hereditary cancer-predisposition and Fanconi anemia disorders. The first gene record is BRCA1 DNA repair associated [1]. The second gene record is BRCA2 DNA repair associated [6].

## Associated Hereditary Cancers

One associated disease is Familial cancer of breast [2]. Another is Familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 1 [3]. Another is Familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 2 [9]. Another is Pancreatic cancer susceptibility 4 [4]. Another is Pancreatic cancer susceptibility 2 [12]. Another is Familial prostate cancer [11].

## Pediatric and Neural Tumors

The associations also include Medulloblastoma [7]. They include Glioma susceptibility 3 [10]. They include Wilms tumor 1 [13].

## Fanconi Anemia

One Fanconi anemia association is Fanconi anemia complementation group S [5]. Another is Fanconi anemia complementation group D1 [8].

## Function and Supporting Records

The gene symbol is BRCA1 [14]. The gene name is BRCA1 [18]. The OMIM entry is BRCA1 DNA REPAIR-ASSOCIATED PROTEIN; BRCA1 [17]. BRCA1 acts as a tumor suppressor that maintains genomic stability [24: "plays a role in maintaining genomic stability, and it also acts as a tumor suppressor"]. Its mutations explain a large share of inherited cases [24: "responsible for approximately 40% of inherited breast cancers and more than 80% of inherited breast and ovarian cancers"]. One annotated process is double-strand break repair via homologous recombination [21]. Another is DNA repair [27].

One ClinVar variant is NM_007294.4(BRCA1):c.5243_5277+2788del [16]. Another is NM_007294.4(BRCA1):c.5277+2916_5277+2946delinsGG [23]. Another is NG_005905.2:g.(147057_150288)_(160933_166866)del [29].

One paper is PTEN alterations in sporadic and BRCA1-associated triple negative breast carcinomas. [15] Another is BRCA1: An Endocrine and Metabolic Regulator. [22] Another is Preneoplastic stromal cells promote BRCA1-mediated breast tumorigenesis. [28] One linked publication is PMID 35263698 [20]. Another is PMID 35432218 [26].

One trial is Germline BRCA1 and BRCA2 Mutations in Jewish Women Affected by Breast Cancer [19]. Another is BRCA1 Haploinsufficiency and Gene Expression [25]. Another is Study to Evaluate Treatment Customized According to RAP80 and BRCA1 in Patients With Advanced Lung Carcinoma [30].
